Subject: Internal: load-test readiness check / routing notes

Internal — quick notes before I reply to Jordan and Contracts:
- Baseline: 95th percentile ~ 540ms on the dedicated pool variant with 512 token avg; optimistic for 2k reqs/min if KV cache hit rates are high.
- Risk areas: long-tail prompts that push >1024 tokens and cross-attention costs. We should mark those in the prompt inventory as "long-context" and gate them in early runs.
- Fallback plan: if we see >650ms at target we will route to a lower-cost variant (quantized) with a preface explaining differences in verbosity/formatting. Diego: we need the prompt examples + expected structured schema to make the preface automatic.

Action items: Sergio to draft routing fallback wording; Diego to add expected structured outputs to the Excel; Priyom to prepare a small canary load script and share the Drive link.

Sergio Alvarez
Principal Infra Engineer | Redwood Inference
